The American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) and other medical organizations have guidelines for the number of attempts to cannulate a patient before escalating the task to a more experienced colleague. According to these guidelines, the recommended number of attempts is typically limited to 3-4 attempts. This is to ensure patient safety and to avoid unnecessary complications.
